scientific_integrity: The classical quantum exterior algebra and Nakayama theory are credited. The claimed observation is parameter-independence of the full automorphism linear representation together with its exact action profiles and an unbounded nonisomorphism ambiguity. Symbolic proof is independent of finite-field checks.
scientific_limitations: Only finite-field k-linear unital algebra automorphisms; excludes zero and both square-one parameters. Possible prior equivalent group-action descriptions under unsearched terminology; not independently audited.
title: Parameter-blind full automorphism representations of quantum exterior algebras over finite fields
